name: fix-deck-config-keys
body: source: 'eypres.yaml holds `title`, `author`, `date`, optional theme/navigation'; inconsistency: whether title/author/date are required, and date's format, were undefined (feedback-3); resolution: `title` required; `author`, `date` optional; `date` is `YYYY-MM-DD`; `theme` optional default `default`; `navigation` optional default `default`; unknown keys = error with suggestion, consistent with field rules — written into the deck-config requirement and domain value [with user]
